chunks: He said: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Musa narrated to us, he said: my father narrated to us, he said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, who said:

When the Day of Resurrection comes, Allah will gather the first and the last people on one plain, then He will command a caller who will proclaim: 'Cast down your gazes and lower your heads until Fatimah, daughter of Muhammad, may God bless him and his family and grant them peace, crosses the Bridge.'

He said: All creation will then cast down their gazes, and Fatimah, peace be upon her, will arrive on a noble mount from among the noble mounts of Paradise, accompanied by seventy thousand angels. She will pause at a distinguished station among the stations of the Day of Judgement, then dismount from her mount and take the shirt of al-Husayn ibn Ali, peace be upon them both, in her hand, soaked with his blood, and say:

'O my Lord, this is the shirt of my son, and You know what was done to him.' Then the proclamation will come to her from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: 'O Fatimah, you have My pleasure.' She will say: 'O my Lord, avenge for me from his killer.' Then Allah, the Most High, will command a flame from the Fire, and it will emerge from Hell and snatch the killers of al-Husayn ibn Ali, peace be upon them both, just as a bird snatches a seed. Then the flame will return with them to the Fire, and they will be subjected to various punishments therein.

Then Fatimah, peace be upon her, will ride her noble mount until she enters Paradise, and with her the escorting angels, her descendants before her, and their friends from among the people on her right and her left.

key_terms.الصراط: al-Sirat — the Bridge over Hellfire that all must cross on the Day of Judgement
key_terms.القيامة: al-Qiyamah — the Day of Resurrection, the final reckoning
key_terms.قميص: Qamis — shirt, garment; here refers to the blood-stained shirt of Imam al-Husayn
key_terms.نجيب: Najib — a noble or purebred riding animal, here from Paradise

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about Fatimah on the Day of Judgement and her plea for justice for Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrates that on the Day of Judgement, Allah will gather all of creation and command them to lower their gazes while Fatimah (AS), daughter of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), crosses the Bridge (al-Sirat). She will arrive on a noble mount from Paradise, escorted by seventy thousand angels, and pause at a distinguished station. She will then dismount and present the blood-soaked shirt of her son al-Husayn (AS), pleading for divine justice. Allah will respond with His pleasure and command a flame from Hell to seize the killers of al-Husayn, devouring them as a bird devours seeds. They will be cast back into the fire for various punishments, while Fatimah remounts and enters Paradise with her angelic escort, her descendants before her, and their followers on her right and left. This tradition was transmitted in the context of honoring the Ahl al-Bayt and commemorating the tragedy of Karbala.
